content_metadata.description: A practical demonstration and guide for building and using a DIY isolation box for home recording.

qAndA.answer: He uses a combination of acoustic foam and window insulation.
qAndA.question: What material does Georg use to fill the gaps around the cables where they enter the isolation box?

qAndA.answer: The brackets provide extra support and ensure that the corners of the box are securely fastened.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of the L-shaped metal brackets used in the construction of the isolation box?

qAndA.answer: He demonstrates the impact of the master volume on the tube amp's distortion and overall guitar tone.
qAndA.question: Why does Georg play the guitar at different master volume levels?

qAndA.answer: He listens to the sound of the guitar through headphones while moving the microphone around until he finds the desired tone.
qAndA.question: How does Georg find the optimal placement for the microphone inside the isolation box?

qAndA.answer: The video maintains an enthusiastic and informative mood, making it both engaging and practical for viewers interested in home recording.

youtube_description:
A tutorial about recording great guitar tones at home without disturbing the neighbors, with a DIY isolation cabinet, or iso box.

I built it in 2007, after being inspired by Matthias IA Eklundh recordings (e.g. his freak guitar albums are recorded this way).

In this video:
I'll show you how I built it
how to record with it
and everything else that should be interesting

Check my older videos for some fully produced songs that I recorded with my isolation box:
Purple Organ (rock sounds)
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YxsXBHGHZGA
Riverdance Theme (clean and vintage lead sound)
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hambh10bdKA
Adagio for Strings (clean and mellow sounds)
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=67hFq-XIbdM
Benny Hill Theme (country clean, sort of)
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gSYPfObmI0M
Castlevenia - some theme (Neoclassical shred)
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n6gktlpAWSQ
